# Dr Vasileva – Psychologist & CBT Psychotherapist

> Dr Mirena Vasileva, PhD – psychologist and CBT psychotherapist. Online and in-person sessions in Bulgarian and English for adults, couples, families, children and teenagers.

This site in Bulgarian: https://drvasileva.bg/
